source_document.scope_note: The attachment is a taxonomy review, not a complete narrative guide. Educational assets also cite existing repository content and the user brief.

visual_review.direction: neutral architectural editorial photography plus original navy/sky-blue SVG diagrams
visual_review.human_art_direction_approval: not_recorded; full set prepared for owner review as requested
visual_review.taxonomy_guardrail: Images do not activate specialties. Landscaping, irrigation and external works include currently non-selectable categories in the supplied draft.
visual_review.engineering_limit: Concept illustrations, not engineering drawings, approved construction methods or compliance certification.

integration_notes.existing_component_reviewed: components/DirectoryResponsiveImage.js has fixed variant widths; do not pass these assets to it without a separately reviewed size adaptation.
integration_notes.heading_structure: Keep one H1; introduce genuine H2 sections and H3 subtopics in HTML. Bold is not a heading substitute.
integration_notes.layout: Use width and height or CSS aspect-ratio, including a media-query ratio for portrait hero and reflowed SVGs. Keep images unmirrored in RTL/LTR.
integration_notes.performance: Choose one responsive image per slot. Hero only may use fetchpriority=high; lazy-load below-fold images. No Core Web Vitals improvement is claimed without testing the future integrated page.
integration_notes.accessibility: Use unique locale-specific alt. Put each numbered diagram legend in HTML adjacent to the image. Complex comparison data should have an accessible HTML table.
integration_notes.mobile_sizes: 900x1200 hero; 600x450 specialty and CTA photos; dedicated narrow SVG layouts.

ar: الصفوف: 01 نطاق الأعمال، 02 المواد، 03 المواصفات، 04 الاستثناءات، 05 المدة، 06 الضمان.
الأعمدة 01–03 عروض افتراضية للتوضيح وليست شركات حقيقية.
علامة الصح: بند موثق للمراجعة، وليست شهادة جودة. علامة الاستفهام: مطلوب توضيح مكتوب. الشرطة: غير مذكور.
قارن السعر بعد توحيد النطاق والمواصفات. لا تُعد كثرة علامات الصح وحدها قرار ترسية.
en: Rows: 01 scope, 02 materials, 03 specifications, 04 exclusions, 05 duration, 06 warranty.
Columns 01–03 are illustrative offers, not real contractors.
Check: documented for review, not certified quality. Question mark: written clarification needed. Dash: not stated.
Compare price after aligning scope and specifications. A count of checks alone is not an award decision.

ar: 01 المخططات المعتمدة، 02 جدول الكميات، 03 العقد ومرفقاته: مرجع مترابط للمشروع.
04 مرحلة أعمال منفذة قابلة للفحص، 05 فحص وتوثيق ومحضر استلام، 06 اعتماد الدفعة وصرفها وفق العقد.
رمز الدرع: توثيق نطاق الضمان ومدته ومسار معالجة العيوب ضمن التسليم.
التسلسل توضيحي؛ الدفعات المقدمة والمحتجزات والمراحل الفعلية تحدد في العقد، ولا يفترض الرسم نسبًا ثابتة أو ضمانًا قانونيًا عامًا.
en: 01 approved drawings, 02 bill of quantities, 03 contract and attachments: a linked project reference.
04 inspectable work milestone, 05 inspection and acceptance record, 06 payment approval and release under the contract.
Shield: document warranty scope, duration and defect handling as part of handover.
This is illustrative. Advances, retention and actual milestones depend on the contract; no fixed percentages or general legal guarantee are implied.
